name: Manyata Tech Park
tagline: Put your work gate on the home-search map.
description: Manyata Business Park is a major office district at Nagavara in North Bengaluru. This locality page is an employment-area search guide for homes around the park, not a claim that every listed home sits inside an office campus. The relevant park gate and residential project entrance are essential to a useful comparison.

faqs.question: How would Aaramv compare homes here?
faqs.answer: We would start with the Manyata gate you use and the hours you travel. From there, we would compare the residential address, home layout and full purchase cost. For a phased development, we would also check the exact tower and schedule, because a workplace-oriented location does not make every phase equally suitable for your move-in plans.
